title: Create real DXR state object and PSO properties
motivation: Pipeline::Create() is a stub that forces raster fallback. We need a real DXR state object so SBT can query valid shader identifiers and DispatchRays can run.
deliverables: A D3D12_STATE_OBJECT_TYPE_RAYTRACING_PIPELINE with subobjects: DXIL library, hit group, shader config, global root signature, pipeline config
Query ID3D12StateObjectProperties and return non-null IDs for 'RayGen', 'Miss', 'HitGroup'
Remove raster fallback when PSO creation succeeds; keep graceful fallback on failure
PIX capture validates non-zero SBT identifiers and shows DispatchRays on GPU timeline
acceptance: App runs without 'PSO properties are null' warning
SBT::Build() completes; GetShaderIdentifier returns non-null for all exports
No D3D12 debug layer errors; warnings allowed
PIX 'Pipeline State Objects' shows a Raytracing PSO with our exports
implementation: In Pipeline::Create(): build an array of D3D12_STATE_SUBOBJECT
- DXIL library (raytracing_lib.dxil) with exports: RayGen, Miss, ClosestHit
- Hit group: type TRIANGLES; CHS=ClosestHit; Export 'HitGroup'
- Shader config: payload 32 bytes (float4 RGBA), attribute 8 bytes (float2 barycentrics)
- Global root signature: reuse existing minimal SRV(t0) + UAV(u0); keep simple for v1
Reserve subobject vector capacity up front (e.g., reserve(6)) so pointers used by associations remain valid
Store the index of the Shader Config subobject; set association->pSubobjectToAssociate = &subobjects[index] AFTER all pushes, or reserve capacity
Ensure export names exactly match HLSL entry names in raytracing_lib.hlsl ([shader("raygeneration")] RayGen, [shader("miss")] Miss, [shader("closesthit")] ClosestHit)
Call ID3D12Device5::CreateStateObject and then QueryInterface for ID3D12StateObjectProperties
Cache m_pso and m_psoProps; expose getters
notes: Keep the root signature minimal; local roots not required in 0017
Do not change SBT layout yet; 0019 adds camera/local roots
If CreateStateObject fails, log HRESULT and keep current raster fallback path
E_INVALIDARG (0x80070057) commonly occurs if subobject association points to an invalid subobject (vector reallocation) or an export name is misspelled/not present in the DXIL library
Validate DXIL contains the expected exports (use dxc/dxil reflection or temporarily reduce to a library with only RayGen+Miss to isolate issues)
troubleshooting: Reserve subobjects: subobjects.reserve(6); capture shaderConfigIndex before pushing more, then reference &subobjects[shaderConfigIndex] in the association
Confirm HLSL function names exactly: RayGen/Miss/ClosestHit. If your functions are named RayGenMain, update exports accordingly
Ensure global root signature pointer lifetime is valid for CreateStateObject (use a local ID3D12RootSignature* that points to the ComPtr held root)
Start minimal: omit the hit group; create library with only RayGen and Miss; once PSO succeeds, add ClosestHit + hit group
Verify DXC target: lib_6_3, and that the produced .dxil is the one being loaded (log absolute path and file size)
test_plan: Run without PIX: animated gradient should appear; logs show PSO creation success
Run in PIX: verify DispatchRays event and that SBT sizes/strides look sane
Force failure by renaming dxil temporarily; ensure app falls back to raster gracefully
